content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets get close to failure (roughly 0-3 reps in reserve). 💪

Heavier work in the 5-8 rep range is still the better choice for your 100 kg bench goal. Strength is specific, so you need to practice heavy benching. Use heavy sets on your main lifts and moderate 8-15 rep sets on accessories to build muscle. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
